title: CCP-16 DIO metric signaling incomplete: no DAG Metric Container, Python emits no SF/RF options, C RF-metrics TLV never emitted (draft 9.2/App B, R-RPL-010/037/038/040)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 9.2 — DAG Metric Container MUST include SF recommendation, per-neighbor EMA, density, utilization (per CCP-16, 02a 4.1-4.2); capability option MUST carry ASSIGNED_SF + per-neighbor EMA + density + utilization + load_factor; App B — parent selection uses that container. Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-010/037/038/040, divergent, confidence high.
Evidence: pseudocode + ccp16-family vectors implemented+tested in all three stacks (Py ccp.py adaptive_sf_select :299/ema :256; Rust lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs; C link/rf_health.c:154; consumers lichen-core/tests/ccp16_*.rs, lichen-rpl/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs:14, lichen/tests/rf_health_vectors/main.c:171, Py test_ccp.py:170-427). DIO side diverges: no RFC 6551 DAG Metric Container anywhere (option-type constant only, Py messages.py:47); ASSIGNED_SF 0x14 wired C (messages.c:920-933, rpl_root.c:215-227, dodag.c:673-680) + Rust (lichen-core sf_assignment.rs, router.rs:1047-1078) but ABSENT in python/src/lichen/rpl/ (grep-verified); C LICHEN_RPL_OPT_RF_METRICS 0x16 helpers (messages.c:935-970) never emitted into a DIO (sole callers lichen/tests/rpl_messages/main.c:807-840); 0x16 wire-type collision Rust DODAG-Version-Authorization vs C RF-metrics already tracked (b7z9.147); parent selection consumes none of these fields (ETX/load are caller parameters).
Suggested placement: decide wire form (dedicated LICHEN options vs real Metric Container — flagged F9 for Opus), then Python DIO signaling + C RF-metrics emission wiring; resolve 0x16 collision via b7z9.147.
